description.value: Egg & Co. is a popular all-day breakfast and brunch spot in Vancouver's Fraserhood neighbourhood on Fraser Street between 26th and 27th. Chef Benjamin Ho puts creative twists on brunch classics like Beef Cheek Benny and Black Truffle & Mushroom Toast alongside traditional eggs bennies and french toast. It's walk-ins only, making it an easy stop for touring cyclists passing through the area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Egg & Co. as an active brunch restaurant at 4245 Fraser St, Vancouver. Phone and address match between OSM and the website contact page. Takeout is confirmed via prominent 'ORDER ONLINE' links and listed delivery platforms (UberEats, SkipTheDishes, DoorDash, Fantuan). Vegetarian and vegan options are confirmed by both OSM tags (diet:vegan=yes, diet:vegetarian=yes) and the menu listing '(vegetarian option available)' on multiple items plus inherently vegetarian dishes. No evidence of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging on the website or in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, active brunch restaurant in a cyclist-accessible Vancouver neighbourhood. Walk-ins only and takeout available make it convenient for touring cyclists, though no bike-specific amenities are confirmed.
